description: Answers for Apple's App Privacy details and Google Play's Data safety form from the SDKs an app uses, their settings and the data the app collects itself. Every answer carries the vendor or store page it comes from. Settings are yes/no questions per SDK (ids like ga.user_id, app.iap); unknown ids are rejected. SDK ids: firebase-analytics, firebase-crashlytics, firebase-auth, firebase-messaging, admob, meta, revenuecat, onesignal, sentry, stripe, mixpanel, amplitude, google-sign-in, sign-in-with-apple, appsflyer. Returns wizardUrl, a privacy-policy wizard link with the same services and personal data filled in. A starting point to check, not legal advice.
name: generate_store_privacy_labels
title: Generate App Store and Google Play privacy label answers
